cards.p: A customer asks where their order is. Tracking says [status]. Reply calmly with the next step and a date.
A shopper asks which size to pick. Using my size chart [paste], reply with one pick and why.
Reply to this return request: [paste]. Follow my policy [policy]. Kind, clear, exact next steps.
Write a short text and email: [product] is back, [quantity] left, link [link]. Under 40 words.
Orders are [days] late because [reason]. Write one email for every buyer: sorry, new date, one choice.
A buyer got the wrong item: [paste]. Reply with one sorry, the fix, and how the swap works.
Write a small card for my packages: thanks, how to care for [product], where to tag us.
Turn my shipping and return rules into a plain policy page with short headings: [paste rules].
Reply to this review about a late package: [paste]. Own our part, say the fix, under 60 words.
Write an email [days] after delivery asking for a review of [product]. One question, one link, no reward.
Group these reviews into what buyers love and what they want changed: [paste]. Top 3 of each.
Pick 3 short buyer quotes from these reviews for my product page. Keep their exact words: [paste].
Write a launch post for [product]: what it is, who it is for, price [price], drop date [date].
Write a 20 second unboxing video script for [product] with a hook in the first 2 seconds.
Write 5 short story posts about how we pack orders. One line each plus a photo idea.
Write a sale email: [percent] off [items] until [date]. Subject line, 3 short lines, one button.
Write a product description for [product] from my notes: [notes]. 80 words, plain words, 3 bullets.
Give me 5 titles for [product] that say what it is, the size and who it is for.
My best sellers are [list]. Suggest 3 bundles, each with a name and a fair bundle price.
Write a photo shot list for [product]: 6 shots, the angle, the background, and what each shows.
Sort these expenses into stock, shipping, fees, ads, packaging: [paste]. Total each. Flag anything twice.
[Product] sells for [price]. Item costs [cost], shipping [cost], fees [cost]. What do I keep per sale?
A shop owes [amount] for a wholesale order, [days] late. Write a polite reminder with a due date and [link].
Here is my stock with units sold: [paste]. Which items move slowly, and what should I do with each?
